Name: NPC_AI_ACTION_PARAM_ST
Description: Pad inputs for one AI action of a character that plays through a virtual pad (human NPCs). The row ID is the action ID that AI scripts pass to attack goals (the NPC_ATK_* constants: 0 R1, 2 R2, 1000+ gestures). While the action runs, the character presses the keys below and holds the move direction.

Fields.Name: Move Direction
Fields.Description: Stick direction held while the action runs: 1 Up (forward), 2 Up-Left, 3 Up-Right, 4 Left, 5 Right, 6 Down (back), 7 Down-Left, 8 Down-Right, at full tilt. 0 = no stick input.

Fields.Name: Key 1
Fields.Description: First pad button pressed for the action. 0 = none. Gesture (22) performs the Gesture ID; Ladder Ascend/Descend (20/21) climb a ladder; Dash (15) presses the roll/dash button as a dash. 10 does nothing.

Fields.Name: Key 2
Fields.Description: Second pad button, pressed together with Key 1 (same values). 0 = none.

Fields.Name: Key 3
Fields.Description: Third pad button, pressed together with Keys 1 and 2 (same values). 0 = none. Retail never sets it.

Fields.Name: Hold Move Direction
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the move direction is applied for the whole action either way. Retail sets it on most rows that have a direction.

Fields.Name: Hold Key 1
Fields.Description: On: Key 1 is held down (long press) instead of tapped, for example charged attacks and guarding (the *Hold rows).

Fields.Name: Hold Key 2
Fields.Description: On: Key 2 is held down (long press) instead of tapped.

Fields.Name: Hold Key 3
Fields.Description: On: Key 3 is held down (long press) instead of tapped. Retail never sets it.

Fields.Name: Gesture ID
Fields.Description: Gesture to perform when a key is Gesture (22); handed to the character's behaviour script as the gesture number. Ignored for other keys. Retail rows 1000–1150 use 0–150.

Fields.Name: Success When Goal Time Runs Out
Fields.Description: On: when the AI goal's time limit runs out during this action, the goal ends as a success instead of a failure. Retail sets it on the R1, R2, L1 and L2 hold rows.
